title_ar: افتتاحية — سؤال لا تجيب عنه علبة الفواتير
title_en: Cold open — the question a shoebox cannot answer
how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

sentences.ar: واحدة صاحبة محل، عندها علبة فيها فواتير، وسؤال واحد: أقفل أنهي يوم في الأسبوع؟
sentences.en: A shopkeeper has a box of receipts and one question: which day of the week should she close?

sentences.ar: مش هتعرف تجاوب بالبصّ، لأن محدش يقدر يمسك ألف صف في دماغه.
sentences.en: She cannot answer it by looking, because a person cannot hold a thousand rows in their head.

sentences.ar: فبتعمل اللي أي حد شغال في الداتا بيعمله.
sentences.en: So she does what every data person does.
She lays the receipts out — gets the rows.

sentences.ar: تشوف مين فيهم تقدر تثق فيه.
sentences.en: She works out which ones she can trust.

sentences.ar: وبعدها تجاوب على السؤال. دي الشغلانة كلها.
sentences.en: And then she answers the question — that is the whole job.

sentences.ar: Spreadsheets وSQL وPython وdashboards وmachine learning كل أداة هنشوفها في الفيديو ده هي طريقة مختلفة لنفس التلات خطوات، بس على حجم أكبر.
sentences.en: Spreadsheets, SQL, Python, dashboards, machine learning — every tool in this film is a different way of doing those same three moves at a different scale.

sentences.ar: والخطوة اللي في النص، اللي محدش بيتكلم عنها، هي أغلب الشغل.
sentences.en: And the unglamorous middle move is most of the work.

sentences.ar: في أسبوع حقيقي هتقضي وقت في اكتشاف إن Cairo وcairo وCairo وبعدها مسافة دول تلات مدن مختلفة عند الكمبيوتر،
sentences.en: In a real week you will spend time discovering that Cairo, cairo and Cairo-with-a-trailing-space are three different cities to a computer,

sentences.ar: أكتر بكتير من الوقت اللي هتبني فيه حاجة ذكية.
sentences.en: far more time than you will spend building anything clever.

sentences.ar: دول ست عمليات دفع من NilePay، خدمة mobile money هنمشي وراها لحد آخر الفيديو. أربعة نجحوا.
sentences.en: Here are six payments from NilePay, a mobile-money service we will follow all the way to the end; four succeeded.

sentences.ar: قبل ما أقولك نسبة النجاح احسبها إنت.
sentences.en: Before I tell you the success rate — work it out.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.
glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: One record in a table: a single entity or event, with one value for each column.
concepts.def_ar: الـrow سجل واحد في الجدول، يمثّل كيان أو حدث واحد وفيه قيمة لكل عمود.
concepts.failure: A bad join duplicates rows, silently inflating every total.

concepts.def_en: Structured Query Language: the standard declarative language for querying and changing data in relational databases by describing what you want.
concepts.def_ar: لغة قياسية تصريحية للاستعلام عن الداتا وتعديلها في الـrelational databases، بتوصف فيها إنت عايز إيه مش إزاي.
concepts.failure: Thinking SQL runs in written order; the engine plans execution in its own order.

concepts.def_en: A readable, general-purpose programming language widely used for data analysis, automation, pipelines and AI work.
concepts.def_ar: لغة برمجة عامة وسهلة القراءة، مستخدمة بكثرة في تحليل الداتا والأتمتة والـpipelines والـAI.
concepts.failure: Using plain loops over huge data instead of vectorized pandas or SQL operations.

concepts.def_en: Building models that learn patterns from data to make predictions, instead of following hand-written rules.
concepts.def_ar: بناء models بتتعلم الأنماط من الداتا عشان تتنبأ، بدل ما تتبع قواعد مكتوبة بإيد الإنسان.
concepts.failure: Evaluating a model on the same data it trained on, hiding overfitting and leakage.

concepts.def_en: Financial services over a mobile phone, such as wallets, transfers and cash in/out, run by providers like the fictional NilePay in this course.
concepts.def_ar: الـmobile money خدمات مالية على الموبايل زي المحافظ والتحويلات وإيداع/سحب الكاش، والكورس بيتابعها مع NilePay (شركة خيالية).
concepts.failure: Treating balances as a simple column update; money movement needs atomic, auditable transactions.

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
A data table (<= 8 columns, <= 12 visible rows); numbers come from a data_ref.
Three gates (e.g. validate -> authorise -> settle) that ignite in turn; a payload passes or is rejected.
The A-01 holo-city map (recurring asset, 04 §7): districts light up; routes between them.
A request travelling hops (client, lb, service, cache, db, queue, external) with per-hop latency.
Trunk chapter title card (riser + sting in the SFX map).
